A story worth returning to.

LinguaNovels is an independent English-learning project built around original fiction. Instead of unrelated listening clips, you follow characters, notice clues and discover what happens next.

Meet The Last Letter

Our first story is a mystery set in Scotland. It has fifteen chapters, each divided into three parts, with adaptations at B1, B2 and C1. The characters and events are fictional.

Designed for independent practice

Each part brings together a short listening activity, vocabulary and six multiple-choice comprehension questions. Explanations help you review your answers. The transcript becomes available after you submit.

About the audio and levels

The narration uses a synthetic British English voice. The level labels are learning guides, not an official assessment or a guarantee of exam equivalence. All audio files have been checked technically; listening review of the complete production is still in progress.
